content.text:
Found this on X, posted Oct 28 by @example_author (https://x.com/example_author/status/1). ESTC was about $97 that day:

"Elastic is the cheapest way to own enterprise AI search. Vector workloads are moving onto it from point products, cloud revenue grew 25% last quarter, and the Nov 16 print should show it speeding up. I'm watching cloud growth and net expansion. If cloud growth slips under 20%, I'm wrong."

Send ESTC to the PEAD Specialist (analyst id cmnhxpjio000004jvox6kl6c7) for a full write-up. Don't research it yourself first.
